summary: Added evals/scenarios.load_corpus(), converting the 150 existing evals/corpora/*.yaml cases into strands_evals.Case objects for the S1-S9 port (10-the-scenario-map.md §7, operator override 2026-09-20). Reuses the existing seeded content unchanged rather than rewriting it. Live-driving a real proactive_decide.yaml case through it found and fixed two real bugs in the new spine, both latent since the SDK-native harness was first built.
details: Bug 1: _as_nora_case() (evals/backbone.py) dropped a case's category entirely. evals/rebuilt/entry.py's dreamer entry point reads case.category or "note-candidates" to pick which dreamer adaptor a pass runs -- every ported category: proactive case silently ran against an adaptor the composed graph never built ('no adaptor note-candidates on the graph'). No hand-written S4/S5/S6 case this session wrote ever set category, so the drop stayed latent until a real corpus case did.

Bug 2: _drive()'s per-case policy passthrough (added earlier this session) never rewrote the policy template's own workspace = "..." to the ISOLATED workspace name -- the same substitution evals/rebuilt/runner.run_once() already does. Without it the composed subject's real memory.workspace_id and its policy's declared room workspace disagreed, and the proactive adaptor reported "no home room" for a workspace whose policy plainly named one.

Both found live (real Postgres via pg_url, real deployed nora alias over the SSH tunnel) and confirmed fixed live: a ported no_trigger case now scores a real PASS end to end, and a ported proactive_decide case runs to completion (a real model call, no ERROR) rather than failing on either bug. Both bugs also regression-tested and falsified mechanically (no DB/network).

load_corpus() carries every field the old harness's own Case read (room/now/policy/config/knows/expect/category) into the SDK Case's metadata under the same names, and 8 mechanical tests (including a fake-task wiring test through a real strands_evals.Experiment + MeetsGrader, falsified both directions) pin the conversion for all 13 corpora, reproducing the known 150-case total.
